display.navBarGlassDesc: A floating translucent pill that blurs the content behind it, with a separate action button.
display.navBarFabDesc: A full-width bar across the bottom, with the action button floating above its right corner.
display.navBarTabsDesc: A full-width bar across the bottom. Nothing floats — the action sits inside the bar as its own tab.
display.navBarCenterDesc: A full-width bar across the bottom, with the action raised over its centre and tabs split around it.
